UNL-001.name: Arena Kingpin
UNL-001.rulesText:
I enter ready.
[E]: Give a unit +3[M] this turn.
UNL-001.flavorText: Don't you dare suggest it's a hairpiece.

UNL-002.name: Inferna
UNL-002.flavorText: "Ironic, isn't it? Water all around us, but your boat's still gonna burn."

UNL-003.name: Mischievous Marai
UNL-003.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me to a battlefield, deal 2 to an enemy unit here.
UNL-003.flavorText: As fickle as the sea, and almost as destructive.

UNL-004.name: Prepared Neophyte
UNL-004.rulesText: If you've spent [4] or more to play a spell this turn, I have +4[M].

UNL-005.name: Revna the Lorekeeper
UNL-005.rulesText:
[Ganking]
When you play a spell, if you spent [4] or more, ready me.
UNL-005.flavorText: "Nothing stops us! Not cold, not death!"

UNL-006.name: Sharkling
UNL-006.flavorText:
"Don't worry, it's only a little one."
—Common last words

UNL-007.name: Smite
UNL-007.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If it would die this turn, banish it instead.

UNL-008.name: Towering Pairofant
UNL-008.rulesText:
[Assault]
If a unit died this turn, I enter ready.

UNL-009.name: Upstage Comedy
UNL-009.flavorText: Art is not always appreciated in its critic's lifetime.

UNL-010.name: Vault Breaker
UNL-010.rulesText:
[Action]
Give a unit [Assault 2] and [Ganking] this turn.
UNL-010.flavorText:
"If you hit a wall, hit it hard!"
—Vi

UNL-011.name: Fresh Beans
UNL-011.rulesText: When you play a unit during a showdown, you may exhaust this to draw 1.

UNL-012.name: Lord Broadmane
UNL-012.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When you play me, give your other units here [Assault] this turn.

UNL-013.name: Lotus Trap
UNL-013.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Reaction]
Choose a unit. Double all damage that would be done to it this turn.

UNL-014.name: Monster Harpoon
UNL-014.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield. If you control a facedown card, deal 4 to it instead.
UNL-014.flavorText: "Ready" and "fire" are easy. Aiming, now that's the hard part.

UNL-015.name: Right to Conquest
UNL-015.rulesText: Draw 1, then draw 1 for each battlefield you or allies control.
UNL-015.flavorText: You get what you can take.

UNL-017.name: Square Up
UNL-017.rulesText:
[Repeat] — Discard 1
Give a unit [Assault 4] this turn.
UNL-017.flavorText: Nothing like a good roar to work up an appetite for violence.

UNL-018.name: Yeti Brawler
UNL-018.rulesText: When I conquer, if you assigned 3 or more excess damage, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted.
UNL-018.flavorText: If you love your job, it's hardly work.

UNL-019.name: Blighted Battleaxe
UNL-019.effectText: At the end of your turn, if I didn't conquer this turn, unattach this and deal 4 to me. [M]+4

UNL-020.name: Dancing Grenade
UNL-020.rulesText: Deal 2 to a unit. Its controller may play this spell again for [A]. If they do, this deals 1 addtional Bonus Damage for each time this spell has dealt damage this turn.
UNL-020.flavorText:
"They're puppets. I pull their strings, and then they dance."
—Jhin

UNL-021.name: Grim Apothecary
UNL-021.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When you play me, you may return a friendly unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand.
UNL-021.flavorText: The cure is better than the disease, but not by much.

UNL-023.name: Katarina, Reckless
UNL-023.rulesText:
When you hide a card, ready me.
When you play a card from face down, deal 2 to an enemy unit.

UNL-025.name: Undying Legion
UNL-025.rulesText: [Legion][>] You may play me from your trash for [3][R].
UNL-025.flavorText: "Choose carefully your oath, lest duty bind you even in death."

UNL-026.name: Xerath, Freed
UNL-026.rulesText: [R], [E]: Deal 3 to a unit. Use this ability only while I'm at a battlefield.
UNL-026.flavorText: "I stand at the brink of infinity."

UNL-027.name: Inviolus Vox
UNL-027.rulesText: When I conquer, give a friendly unit +8[M] this turn.
UNL-027.flavorText:
"Flee him, fight him, or worship him—it matters not! We are but ashes in his flame."
—Herald of Dragons

UNL-028.name: Pyke, Dockside Butcher
UNL-028.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Ganking]
You may pay [R] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, ready me and give me +2[M] this turn.

UNL-029.name: Red Brambleback
UNL-029.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
Your conquer effects for conquering here trigger an additional time.
When I conquer, [Buff] a friendly unit.

UNL-031.name: Combat Experience
UNL-031.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a unit +1[M] this turn.
[Level 6][>] Give it +3[M] this turn instead.

UNL-032.name: Double Trouble
UNL-032.rulesText:
[Repeat] [2]
Look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest.
UNL-032.flavorText: Two heads pay better than one.

UNL-033.name: Frisky Hunter
UNL-033.rulesText: When you play me, play a 1[M] Bird unit token with [Deflect] here.
UNL-033.flavorText: Always following the scent of prey.

UNL-034.name: Herald of Spring
UNL-034.rulesText:
[Hunt]
When you play me, gain 2 XP.
UNL-034.flavorText:
"I have a crown, but no throne; many followers, but no subjects. Who am I?"
—Ionian riddle

UNL-035.name: Monch
UNL-035.rulesText: If an opponent controls a stunned unit, I cost [2] less and enter ready.
UNL-035.flavorText: Just because it doesn't exist doesn't mean it can't hurt you.

UNL-036.name: Mutated Mouser
UNL-036.flavorText: One of the few cats that can scratch its own belly.

UNL-037.name: Shadow Watcher
UNL-037.rulesText: If a friendly unit died during your Beginning Phase this turn, I enter ready.

UNL-038.name: Skyward Strike
UNL-038.rulesText:
Move an enemy unit.
[Level 6][>] [Stun] an enemy unit.
UNL-038.flavorText: Take a moment to heel up.

UNL-040.name: Wuju Apprentice
UNL-040.flavorText: "I've learned a great deal during my apprenticeship. Allow me to demonstrate."

UNL-041.name: Allay, Eager Admirer
UNL-041.rulesText:
[Deflect]
While I'm at a battlefield, your other units here have [Deflect].
UNL-041.flavorText: "Hey, Vex! Look what I've got! It's a surprise! For you! Aren't you excited?!"

UNL-042.name: Back Off
UNL-042.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
[Stun] a unit.
If you played this from your hand, draw 1.

UNL-043.name: Enthusiastic Promoter
UNL-043.rulesText:
[Backline]
When I hold, [Buff] all units here.
UNL-043.flavorText: "Step right up and see the Mechanized Menace versus the Midtown Mauler! Mmmm, it's gonna be good!"

UNL-044.name: Flurry of Feathers
UNL-044.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose one —
• Counter a spell.
• Play four 1[M] Bird unit tokens with [Deflect].

UNL-045.name: Forgotten Signpost
UNL-045.rulesText: [Action][>] Exhaust a unit you control, [E]: Move a different unit you control to the location of the unit you exhausted to pay for this ability.
UNL-045.flavorText:
Great City of Demacia — 470
Immortal Bastion — 2,105
Bandle City — ????

UNL-046.name: Friendship
UNL-046.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a unit. Give it +1[M] this turn for each of the following tags among your units — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro.

UNL-047.name: Mosstomper
UNL-047.flavorText: Sometimes you gotta stomp some moss.

UNL-048.name: Trevor Snoozebottom
UNL-048.rulesText:
[Shield]
When I hold, play a ready 3[M] Sprite unit token with [Temporary] here.
UNL-048.flavorText: He's raised sleepwalking to an art form.

UNL-050.name: Iascylla
UNL-050.rulesText: When I hold, at the start of your next Main Phase, you may move an enemy unit to this battlefield.
UNL-050.flavorText: Irresistible as a whirlpool, and even more deadly.

UNL-051.name: Ivern, Nurturer
UNL-051.rulesText: When you play me or when I hold, look at the top 3 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a unit from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest. Then if you revealed a Bird, Cat, Dog, or Poro, do this: [Buff] a friendly unit.

UNL-052.name: Nami, Headstrong
UNL-052.rulesText:
You may pay [G] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, [Stun] an enemy unit.
When I hold, the next time you play a unit this turn, ready it and [Buff] it.

UNL-053.name: Scuttle Crab
UNL-053.rulesText:
When you play me, draw 1.
[Deathknell][>] Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. You can look at their facedown cards this turn. Gain 1 XP.
UNL-053.flavorText: As harmless as it is delicious.

UNL-054.name: Tricksy Tentacles
UNL-054.rulesText: Move any number of enemy units with the same controller and a total Might of 8 or less to a single location.

UNL-055.name: Vex, Mocking
UNL-055.rulesText:
[Shield]
[Tank]
When you [Stun] an enemy unit at a battlefield, you may move me to that battlefield.

UNL-056.name: Yuumi, Magical Cat
UNL-056.rulesText: When I attack or defend, give one of your other units here +3[M] and [Tank] this turn.
UNL-056.flavorText: "Who's ready to risk our lives, defeat our foes, and maybe knock over some cups?"

UNL-057.name: Alpha Wildclaw
UNL-057.rulesText:
[Tank]
Units here with less Might than me cannot be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.
UNL-057.flavorText: Best take care of the big one, before it takes care of you.

UNL-058.name: Lillia, Protector of Dreams
UNL-058.rulesText:
When you play a token unit, give me +1[M] this turn.
Your token units have [Tank].

UNL-059.name: Master Yi, Unstoppable
UNL-059.rulesText:
[Level 3][>] I cost [2][G] less.
[Level 6][>] I cost [4][G][G] less instead.
[Level 11][>] I cost [6][G][G][G] less instead.
[Level 16][>] I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities.

UNL-060.name: Vilemaw
UNL-060.rulesText:
[Ambush]
Enemy units here with less Might than me don't deal combat damage.
UNL-060.flavorText: Its lair lies beyond a twisted treeline.

UNL-063.name: Eclipse
UNL-063.flavorText: When sun and moon meet, darkness triumphs.

UNL-064.name: Fate Weaver
UNL-064.rulesText: When you play me, look at the top 4 card of your Main Deck. You may reveal a spell with Energy cost [4] or more from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest.
UNL-064.flavorText: "Long or short, every thread must meet the shears in the end."

UNL-065.name: Icevale Archer
UNL-065.rulesText: When I attack, you may pay [1] to give a unit here -1[M] this turn.

UNL-066.name: Moonlight Affliction
UNL-066.flavorText: Light can illuminate, or it can blind.

UNL-067.name: Ruined Rex
UNL-067.flavorText: It's back, and worse than ever.

UNL-068.name: Spectral Centaur
UNL-068.rulesText: When another friendly unit dies, give me +2[M] this turn.
UNL-068.flavorText: Death provides him with an ever-growing herd.

UNL-069.name: Sprite Burst
UNL-069.rulesText: Play two ready 3[M] Sprite unit tokens with [Temporary].

UNL-071.name: Chakram Dancer
UNL-071.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When you play me, give your other units here [Shield] this turn.

UNL-072.name: Crescent Strike
UNL-072.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose a battlefield and an enemy unit there. Deal 4 to that unit and 1 to each other enemy unit there.
UNL-072.flavorText: The light of the moon is cold, yet burns.

UNL-073.name: Deadly Flourish
UNL-073.rulesText: Deal 3 to an enemy unit. When it dies this turn, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
UNL-073.flavorText:
"The world is cruel. It does not have to be ugly."
—Jhin

UNL-074.name: Frigid Jewel
UNL-074.rulesText: When you draw your second card each turn, give a friendly unit +2[M] this turn.
UNL-074.flavorText: The power of the Freljord shines from every facet.

UNL-076.name: Petal Pixie
UNL-076.rulesText: I have +1[M] for each of your units with [Temporary] at my battlefield.
UNL-076.flavorText: She savors fleeting moments of beauty, knowing none but herself will ever see them.

UNL-077.name: Soul Shepherd
UNL-077.flavorText: A strange guardian for a stranger flock.

UNL-078.name: Sprite Fountain
UNL-078.rulesText:
[Temporary]
When you play this, play a ready 3[M] Sprite unit token with [Temporary] to your base.
[Deathknell][>] Repeat this gear's play effect.

UNL-079.name: Diana, Lunari
UNL-079.rulesText: When a showdown begins here, you may pay [1]. If you do, [Predict], then reveal the top ccard of your Main Deck. If it's a spell, draw it.

UNL-080.name: Hwei, Brooding Painter
UNL-080.rulesText:
When I move, draw 1, then discard 1. Then, do the following based on the discarded card's type:
• Spell — Draw 1.
• Gear — Ready up to 2 runes.
• Unit — Give me +3[M] this turn.

UNL-081.name: Keeper of Masks
UNL-081.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Temporary]
When you play me, play two Reflection unit tokens here. Then do this: They become copies of me.

UNL-082.name: Lillia, Fae Fawn
UNL-082.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I move from a location, play a 3[M] Sprite unit token with [Temporary] there.

UNL-083.name: Smoke and Mirrors
UNL-083.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Choose a unit you control and another unit you control at another location. If at least one of them has [Temporary], move each to the other's location. Draw 1.

UNL-084.name: Sprite Queen
UNL-084.rulesText: When you play me or at the start of your Beginning Phase, play a ready 3[M] Sprite unit token with [Temporary] to your base.

UNL-086.name: Zilean, Time Mage
UNL-086.rulesText: Once each turn, if you would play a token unit while I'm at a battlefield, you may play that token and an additional copy of it instead.
UNL-086.flavorText: "I feel like I've done this before."

UNL-087.name: Blue Sentinel
UNL-087.rulesText:
[Shield 2]
Your hold effects for holding here trigger an additional time.
When I hold, [Add] [A] at the start of your next Main Phase.

UNL-088.name: Gutter Palace
UNL-088.rulesText:
At the start of your Beginning Phase, if you have exactly 4 cards in hand and exactly 4 units at battlefields, you win the game.
Discard 1, [E]: Play a 1[M] Bird unit token with [Deflect].

UNL-089.name: Jhin, Meticulous Killer
UNL-089.rulesText:
[Vision]
If you've spent [4] or more to play a spell this turn, you may play me for [B].
UNL-089.flavorText: "One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four ..."

UNL-090.name: LeBlanc, Everywhere at Once
UNL-090.rulesText:
[Backline]
Your [Temporary] effects at my battlefield don't trigger.
UNL-090.flavorText: "Vision. Might. Guile. It's almost comical how history repeats itself."

UNL-091.name: Concentrate
UNL-091.rulesText:
Draw 2.
[Level 6][>] This costs [2] less.
[Level 11][>] This costs [4] less instead.

UNL-092.name: Demacian Diplomat
UNL-092.rulesText: When you play me, gain 1 XP.
UNL-092.flavorText: After decades in the Demacian diplomatic corps, he's found dozens of polite ways to say "leave us alone."

UNL-093.name: Dragonsoul Sage
UNL-093.flavorText: "The Dragon's secrets aren't mine to share. I can only share the gifts that it has given me."

UNL-094.name: Gemhand Hunter
UNL-094.flavorText: He's a yordle of many facets.

UNL-095.name: Grim Resolve
UNL-095.rulesText:
[Action]
Give a friendly unit +3[M] this turn. When it wins a combat this turn, gain 2 XP.
UNL-095.flavorText: "If you think losing is the best teacher, you should really give winning a try."

UNL-097.name: Kinkou Initiate
UNL-097.rulesText: When you play me, draw 1 if your other units have total Might 5 or more.

UNL-098.name: Targonian Visionary
UNL-098.flavorText: She has seen the world before. She will see that world again.

UNL-100.name: Voracious Gromp
UNL-100.flavorText: "Oh no! It's real! The Gromp is real!"

UNL-101.name: Call to Battle
UNL-101.rulesText: Move a unit you control to a battlefield you control. Then, choose an opponent. They move a unit they control to the same battlefield.
UNL-101.flavorText: "I said, what're you gonna do about it?!"

UNL-102.name: Crowd Favorite
UNL-102.flavorText: "The crowd is a beast like any other. Hear it roar?"

UNL-103.name: Disposal Order
UNL-103.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose one —
• Choose up to 3 cards from opponents' trashes. Their owners recycle them.
• Draw 1.
UNL-103.flavorText: "Get it cleaned up by sunrise. No questions."

UNL-104.name: Gentle Gemdragon
UNL-104.rulesText: When you play me or another Dragon, ready up to 2 runes.

UNL-105.name: Imposing Challenger
UNL-105.rulesText: When I move, you may move an enemy unit here with less Might than me to a different battlefield.
UNL-105.flavorText: "Are there truly none with the courage to face our new champion?"

UNL-106.name: Repulse
UNL-106.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a friendly unit at a battlefield. Counter an enemy spell or ability that chooses it and no other friendly unit.

UNL-107.name: Stare Down
UNL-107.rulesText: Choose a friendly unit and a battlefield. Move all enemy units at that battlefield with less Might than the chosen unit to their base. Gain 1 XP.

UNL-108.name: Wily Newtfish
UNL-108.rulesText: If you've gained XP this turn, I have +1[M] and [Ganking].
UNL-108.flavorText: Half newt, half fish. All nuisance.

UNL-109.name: Blood Rose
UNL-109.rulesText:
When you play a unit, you may pay [1] to gain 1 XP.
Spend 3 XP, [E]: Ready a unit.
UNL-109.flavorText: Anything to get the blood pumping.

UNL-110.name: Clash of Giants
UNL-110.rulesText: Choose two units. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
UNL-110.flavorText:
"The land slumbers, but it is not dead. With my roar, I wake it. With my thunder, I call it."
—Volibear

UNL-112.name: Irresistible Faefolk
UNL-112.rulesText: When I move to a battlefield, you may move an enemy unit to that battlefield.

UNL-114.name: Nidalee, Cat Form
UNL-114.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When I win a combat, draw 1.

UNL-115.name: Nilah, Joyful Ascetic
UNL-115.flavorText: "All I feel is joy! It is ... difficult."

UNL-116.name: Poppy, Paragon
UNL-116.rulesText:
[Deflect]
When you play me, if an opponent's score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, ready me and gain 3 XP.

UNL-117.name: Arachnoid Horror
UNL-117.rulesText:
[Hunt 2]
I can be played to an occupied battlefield if an enemy unit is alone there.
Friendly units can be played to an occupied battlefield if an enemy unit is alone there.

UNL-118.name: Elder Dragon
UNL-118.rulesText:
Any amount of your damage is enough to kill enemy units.
When you play me, choose up to one enemy unit at each location. Deal 1 to them.
UNL-118.flavorText: Clearing the dragons out of the mountains just made room for a bigger dragon.

UNL-119.name: Kha'Zix, Evolving Hunter
UNL-119.rulesText:
[Hunt]
When I attack, you may spend 3 XP to deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.

UNL-120.name: Rengar, Trophy Hunter
UNL-120.rulesText:
[Ambush]
I can [Ambush] to a battlefield where there are enemy units, even if you don't have units there.

UNL-121.name: Bewitching Spirit
UNL-121.rulesText: When you play me, choose a player. They discard 1.
UNL-121.flavorText: Bandle Scout Rule 43: When a mysterious voice in the woods whispers for you to follow it, don't go alone. Your friends might want to see too!

UNL-122.name: Cresent Guardian
UNL-122.rulesText: If you've played a spell this turn, you may pay [P] as an additional cost to play me. If you do, I enter ready.
UNL-122.flavorText: The Lunari have few allies among Targon's mortal denizens, but that doesn't mean they're alone.

UNL-123.name: Evershade Stalker
UNL-123.rulesText: When you play me, discard 1, then draw 1.
UNL-123.flavorText:
"That's a LOT of eyes."
—Common last words

UNL-124.name: Isolate
UNL-124.rulesText: Move an enemy unit from a battlefield to its base. Then, if there's an enemy unit alone at the battlefield, draw 1.

UNL-126.name: Megatusk
UNL-126.rulesText: Spend 3 XP: Give your units here [Ganking] this turn.
UNL-126.flavorText:
Q: What do you do if there's a megatusk in your boat?
A: Buy a new boat.

UNL-127.name: Mister Root
UNL-127.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I move to a battlefield, gain 2 XP.
UNL-127.flavorText: Dreams themselves can dream as well.

UNL-128.name: Star-Crossed
UNL-128.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Return a friendly unit and an enemy unit to their owners' hands.
UNL-128.flavorText: "I've made my preparations. Meet me on the ridge at midnight, and we'll go." —Unsigned note

UNL-129.name: Vicious Snapjaws
UNL-129.rulesText: When another friendly unit dies, gain 1 XP.
UNL-129.flavorText: They don't know friend or foe, only food.

UNL-130.name: Walking Roost
UNL-130.rulesText:
[Deflect]
When you play me, choose an opponent. They play a 1[M] Bird unit token with [Deflect].
UNL-130.flavorText: They have to leave the nest eventually.

UNL-131.name: Abandon
UNL-131.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Counter a spell. Return it to its owner's hand instead of putting it in their trash.
[Predict]

UNL-132.name: Angler Beast
UNL-132.rulesText: When you play me, return all units with 2[M] or less to their owners' chands.
UNL-132.flavorText:
"There's plenty of room for everyone at the bottom of the sea."
—Pyke

UNL-133.name: Blast Cone
UNL-133.rulesText:
When you play this, you may move an enemy unit.
When you move an enemy unit, you may exhaust this to [Stun] it.

UNL-134.name: Existential Dread
UNL-134.rulesText:
[Action]
[Repeat] [2]
[Stun] an attacking enemy unit, If it's already stunned, return it to its owner's hand instead.

UNL-135.name: Insightful Investigator
UNL-135.rulesText: When you play me, choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. You may pay 2 XP to choose a card from their hand. If you do, they discard that card and draw 1.

UNL-136.name: Scryer's Bloom
UNL-136.rulesText:
This enters exhausted.
Kill this, [1], [E]: [Predict 2], then draw 1. Gain 1 XP.

UNL-137.name: Sinister Poro
UNL-137.rulesText: When I attack, you may pay [1] to move an enemy unit here to its base.
UNL-137.flavorText: Are you going to be the one to tell him he's not scary?

UNL-138.name: The List
UNL-138.rulesText:
As you play this, name a tag.
[E]: Give a unit with the named tag -2[M] this turn.
UNL-138.flavorText: There are some lists you don't want to be on.

UNL-139.name: Bone Skewer
UNL-139.rulesText:
[Hidden]
Choose a battlefield. An opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a unit from it. They play that unit to that battlefield, ignoring any and all costs. If they do, then do this: [Stun] it.

UNL-140.name: Conscription
UNL-140.rulesText:
You may spend 5 XP as an additional cost to play this.
Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield with 3[M] or less. If you paid the additional cost, choose any enemy unit at a battlefield instead. Take control of it, exhaust it, and recall it.

UNL-141.name: Evelynn, Entrancing
UNL-141.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Backline]
When you play me from facedown on your turn, you may move an enemy unit at a different location to my battlefield.
UNL-141.flavorText: "Girls just wanna tear your throat out with their teeth."

UNL-142.name: Heedless Resurrection
UNL-142.rulesText:
[Reaction]
As an additional cost to play this, kill a friendly unit.
Play a unit from your trash that costs no more Energy and no more Power than the killed unit, ignoring its cost.

UNL-143.name: Kha'Zix, Mutating Horror
UNL-143.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When I attack or defend, if an enemy unit is alone here, give me +2[M] this turn and gain 2 XP.

UNL-144.name: Maduli the Gatekeeper
UNL-144.rulesText:
I can't be readied.
[P]: Move me to an occupied enemy battlefield if my Might is greater than the total Might of enemy units there.
UNL-144.flavorText:
"... Made a song so eerie, thought I'd die."
—Old Gaff's tale

UNL-145.name: Pyke, Returned
UNL-145.rulesText:
[Hidden]
